sourcesRead.findings: Identity: Ulf Michael Widenius, known as Monty, Finnish programmer, born March 3, 1962 in Helsinki. Describes TCX with Allan Larsson in 1985 and Sun departure announced February 5, 2009.

sourcesRead.findings: December 4, 2012 original announcement names Widenius, David Axmark and Allan Larsson. Interim CTO Widenius; board elections planned February 2013.
sourcesRead.caution: Announcement describes application for US 501(c)(3) status, not confirmed approval. Preserve shared founding and distinguish foundation from commercial company.
